reviews.author: Guy Davis
reviews.text:
This selling process could not have been easier.  The three step process and 14 day closing went exactly as advertised.  Jimmy met us at our property on a Friday and by Monday morning we had a fair and reasonable offer on the table.  After our initial meeting, we completed everything else remotely…..even the closing.  Jimmy was professional and remained available throughout the  entire process.
If you have an ‘as is’ property you want to sell with minimal hassle and top notch reputable service, we recommend Jimmy and his three step house buying process.
-Thank you

reviews.author: Susan McClendon
reviews.text: Mr Harris is an honest professional.

reviews.author: Danny Johnson
reviews.text: Jimmy at We Buy Houses in West Georgia are the real deal! So many people told me they would offer a good price and then could not close. I wish I had saved myself a lot of time and trouble and just contacted these guys first! Highly recommend.

reviews.author: Heather Kirby
reviews.text: Jimmy and his team at We buy houses in West Georgia are top notch. They made our home selling experience very simple and quick. Any questions we had throughout the process were answered in a timely manner. I definitely recommend them if you are looking to sell your home. I would definitely use them again!!!

reviews.author: Kevin Richards
reviews.text: I wish I could give Jimmy and the team more than 5 stars.  The whole process was quick, efficient, and professional.  Everything was completed faster than I thought possible, I received a great offer on my property, and everything was done based on what was best for me.  If I ever have another property to sell, I will do business with Jimmy and team again, and will recommend them as often as I possibly can.

reviews.author: Wanda Padgett
reviews.text:
We were VERY satisfied with our house selling experience with Jimmy. He was  Professional and stayed in touch on the process that was closed on the date expected. We had 3 offers taking the  offer above our asking price.
5 stars !!

reviews.author: Yontrea E
reviews.text: This company was great to work with!! The company viewed my home and provided a QUICK offer that was closed SPEEDILY!! All of my questions were answered right away, and the best offer was provided for the purchase of my home. It was a pleasure to work with you!!

reviews.author: Lauren Wall
reviews.text: Quick and easy process, once I had all my paperwork in order we were at closing within the week. Great people to work with would definitely recommend to anyone.

reviews.author: Nick Castello
reviews.text: Jimmy and his team really know their stuff and were a pleasure to work with. When I'm ready to sell another house in Georgia I will certainly be giving him a call!!

reviews.author: Cheralyn Pilgrim
reviews.text: Jimmy & Rob are fantastic to work with! As an agent I brought them many deals, they always closed on every home we got under contract! I have witnessed first hand the quality work they put into every home renovation that they've completed. I HIGHLY RECOMMEND CONTACTING JIMMY IF YOU HAVE A HOME THAT YOU NEED TO SELL FAST. You can rest assured that any dealings with Jimmy & Rob will be top notch and handled with utmost honesty and respect for all parties involved.

reviews.author: Kay Sikes
reviews.text:
Trust on keeping word and following up. The whole transaction was done remotely. Eventhough there were problems getting some papers documented for the title company Jimmy never lost confidence that the snags would be cleared.
You can have confidence doing business with Harris Walker Properties.

reviews.author: Jeremy Stewart
reviews.text: I have known Jimmy for over twenty years. I had a friend that needed to sell an older rental that was in bad shape. Jimmy was able to give my friend an offer she liked and she was able to sell the rental quickly and move on. I highly recommend We Buy Houses In West Georgia to anyone who has a house they want to sell quick without putting it on the market.

reviews.author: Sam Swearingen
reviews.text: I have worked with Jimmy and Rob on several projects over the past few years. They are not your typical wholesalers. They always treat the people they work with fairly and with respect. If you have a house you need to sell quickly I recommend you call Jimmy.

reviews.author: Loretta Morris
reviews.text: Jimmy and his team helped me sell two houses. They are knowledgeable and always willing to help. They made the selling process very easy. I recommend calling Jimmy if you have a house to sell.
